params.prompt: Take this photograph and age it 50 years as a physical print: fade the colors heavily toward yellow, wash out the blacks to grey-brown, desaturate strongly, add coarse film grain, soft focus loss at the edges, slight color bleeding, light surface scratches and one faint crease, dust specks, darkened vignette corners, the look of a 1976 color print that sat in a humid album for five decades. Change NOTHING about the content, people, composition or framing — only the physical aging of the print. No text anywhere.
